categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of micro-nano direct write lithography equipment and direct imaging equipment, primarily serving the PCB and broad semiconductor markets. Its product portfolio includes PCB direct imaging equipment and automated lines, broad semiconductor direct write lithography equipment and automated lines, laser direct imaging equipment, and related after-sales maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include micro-nano direct write lithography, laser direct imaging (LDI), multi-axis synchronous compensation algorithms, high-precision UV optical systems, real-time autofocus, ECC error correction, and high-speed graphic processing. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) and platform-based R&D management, focusing on high-resolution lithography (down to 2μm line width), digital mask technology, and advanced packaging equipment such as wafer alignment and bonding machines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading PCB manufacturers, semiconductor packaging and testing companies, and display panel producers. The company serves high-end PCB markets including HDI, IC substrates, flexible PCBs, and advanced semiconductor packaging sectors such as wafer-level packaging (WLP), panel-level packaging (PLP), and third-generation semiconductors. Major clients include Pengding Holdings, VTEC, CMK, BOE, and other top-tier domestic and international enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hefei, Anhui Province, and subsidiaries in Suzhou and Thailand. It has expanded its international footprint with a focus on Southeast Asia, especially Thailand and Vietnam, and has penetrated markets in Japan, South Korea, and other regions through strategic partnerships and local subsidiaries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing critical lithography and imaging equipment used in PCB manufacturing and semiconductor packaging processes. It also engages in upstream R&D and downstream after-sales services, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier within the semiconductor and PCB manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-end PCB equipment technology, accelerating broad semiconductor applications, and expanding global market presence. R&D focuses on enhancing lithography resolution, throughput, and stability, developing advanced packaging solutions including wafer bonding and alignment, and innovating in laser drilling and direct imaging technologies. The company emphasizes IPD system integration, patent portfolio expansion, and collaboration with academic and research institutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithography and imaging equipment to PCB and semiconductor manufacturers, supplemented by maintenance and technical support services. The company also engages in equipment leasing and collects rental fees. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels with some use of distributors, especially for overseas markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants such as Orbotech (acquired by KLA-Tencor), Heidelberg Instruments, ORC, and ADTEC. It is recognized as a leading domestic supplier of direct write lithography equipment in China, with product performance comparable to international competitors. Its competitive advantages include high precision, cost-effectiveness, and strong local service capabilities, enabling it to gain market share in both domestic and international high-end PCB and semiconductor equipment markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 953.9 million, a 15.09% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 160.7 million, a 10.38% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 2.79 billion, up 12.43%, and net assets were RMB 2.06 billion, up 1.52%. The company has shown steady growth driven by PCB business expansion and international market penetration, with significant R&D investment accounting for over 10% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its core micro-nano direct write lithography technology, offering high-resolution, high-precision, and high-throughput equipment tailored for advanced PCB and semiconductor packaging applications. Its products provide superior line width consistency, edge roughness, and alignment accuracy, combined with cost advantages and rapid local service response. The company’s integrated product platforms and continuous innovation enable it to meet evolving customer demands in AI chips, advanced packaging, new energy vehicles, and new display technologies, positioning it as a key enabler of domestic semiconductor equipment independence and global competitiveness.
